baseline_plan.title: Soft Blanket Cushion for Chair Seat
baseline_plan.summary: Place the blanket on the office chair seat to create a soft resting surface for the small fragile object.

steps.action: Unfold blanket_01 and adjust its size to match the chair seat dimensions.
steps.why_it_helps: Prepares the blanket for placement as a cushion.

steps.action: Lay the adjusted blanket flat on the seat of office_chair_01, smoothing out wrinkles.
steps.why_it_helps: Creates a soft surface for the fragile object to rest on.

assumptions: The blanket provides adequate softness to protect the fragile object.
The small fragile object is light enough not to compress the blanket excessively.
unresolved_risks: The blanket may shift during use, potentially exposing the object to the hard chair surface.
The object may slide off the blanket if not centered.
constraint_check: No permanent modifications - blanket placed loosely on chair.
No damage to inventory objects - blanket and chair remain unchanged.
Only listed inventory objects used - office_chair_01 and blanket_01.
External resource (small fragile object) not modified.
